notes.title: 🎉 Release Announcement 🎉 New Perspective Launches July 17!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]After months of passion, writing, late-night testing (and [i]blushing[/i] scenes), I'm beyond thrilled to announce:[/p][p]🌟 [i][b]New Perspective[/b][/i][b] officially releases on Steam on[/b]
🗓️ [b]July 17, 2025[/b]
🕔 [b]5:00 PM CEST / 11:00 AM EDT / 8:00 AM PDT[/b][/p][p]I can't wait for you to finally experience the story I’ve poured my heart into.[/p][hr][/hr][p]💋 [b]What is [i]New Perspective[/i]?[/b]
A branching [b]adult visual novel[/b] filled with:[/p][list][*][p]Beautiful Characters[/p][/*][*][p]Mature relationships[/p][/*][*][p]Intimate moments (18+)[/p][/*][*][p]And interesting (and kinky 😳) Storylines[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you're here for the romance, the spice, or the story—there’s something waiting for you.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🛒 [b]Where to Get It?[/b]
Wishlist and follow the game on Steam now:
👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2545010/New_Perspective/" style="button"][b]New Perspective - Store Page[/b][/url][/p][p]Every wishlist before launch [i]massively[/i] helps push the game into visibility—so thank you in advance! 💖[/p][hr][/hr][p]⏰ [b]Quick Time Zone Reference[/b]
To make sure you don’t miss the moment:[/p][list][*][p]🇩🇪 Germany / CEST: [b]5:00 PM[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🇺🇸 US Eastern / EDT: [b]11:00 AM[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🇺🇸 US Pacific / PDT: [b]8:00 AM[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]📸 Want to support the launch?[/p][list][*][p]Share this post[/p][/*][*][p]Post screenshots & reactions on Day One[/p][/*][*][p]Leave a review—it helps [i]so much[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Tell a friend who’s into adult visual novels 😉[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for following along this journey. Let’s make this launch one to remember![/p][p]With love,
the Developer of [i]New Perspective[/i][/p]
